113746.name: Charizard — Generations: Radiant Collection RC5/RC32
113746.note: Radiant Collection holo (plain, not full art). NM raw ~$10-13 in 2024; ~$20.95 early 2026 (one tracker, approximate date); peaked ~$63 during the 30th-anniversary run-up. eBay solds ran $26-60 in July 2026, mostly $30s-low $40s. PSA 10 scarce (~5% gem rate).

284266.name: Gengar — SWSH11: Lost Origin Trainer Gallery TG06/TG30
284266.hype: Mega Evolution era spotlight: Mega Gengar ex (MEGA Dream ex 240/193, ~$674) and Mega Gengar tins
284266.note: Plain Trainer Gallery holo (no V). Raw was ~$4-10 in 2023-24. Setmates in the LO Trainer Gallery sell for $1.49-$8.76. PSA 10 sources disagree ($400 vs $676). Lost Origin out of print since 2023; SWSH sets not reprinted after rotation.
